SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW v1 AS VALUES (1, 2, 2), (2, 1, 1) AS t(a, b, k)
SESSION	CREATE TEMPORARY VIEW v2 AS VALUES (1, 2, 2), (2, 1, 1) AS t(a, b, all)
READ	SELECT max(a) AS b FROM v1 GROUP BY k ORDER BY b
READ	SELECT max(a) FROM v2 GROUP BY all ORDER BY all
READ	SELECT (SELECT b FROM v1 ORDER BY all LIMIT 1) FROM v2
